users.title: Users
users.intro: Everyone who can sign in to your organisation, their roles and their access.
users.inviteIntro: They get a link valid for 7 days. They join with the role you choose.
users.devLink: No email service is set up in this environment. Open this link to accept the invitation:
users.usernameIntro: For field staff, interns and volunteers without email. You get a one-time password to print or read out.
users.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dots. They sign in with your organisation code and this username.
users.slipIntro: Give this slip to the person. They choose their own password the first time they sign in.
users.resetIntro: They will be signed out everywhere and must sign in with the new one-time password, then choose their own.
users.cannotEditSelf: You cannot change your own roles. Ask another Admin or the Secretary.
users.search: Search by name, email or username

slip.title: ImpactOS sign-in slip
slip.name: Name
slip.note: Choose a new password the first time you sign in. Do not share this slip.
slip.onlyOnce: This password is shown only now. If it is lost, reset it again.

scope.all: Sees all programs and branches (from their role).
scope.nothingYet: Programs and branches can be assigned once they are added to ImpactOS. Until then this person sees what their role allows.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: What each role can do. Built-in roles are fixed; copy one to make your own.
roles.cloneIntro: Start from an existing role and change its name, access and permissions.
roles.systemLocked: This is a built-in role. Copy it to make changes.
roles.name: Role name
roles.requiresMfa: Require two-step sign-in for this role
roles.grantsAllNote: The Secretary has every permission, including ones added later.

perm.admin_users_manage: Invite people, create username accounts, change roles and status
perm.admin_positions_view: See positions and who holds them
perm.pii_medical_view: See medical, disability and caste details

roles.heldBy: {n, plural, =0 {Nobody holds this role} one {Held by 1 person} other {Held by # people}}

positions.title: Positions
positions.intro: Posts in your organisation. Approvals will route to positions, so they keep working when people change.
positions.formIntro: For example Executive Director, Finance Manager or Procurement Committee.
positions.name: Position name
positions.isCommittee: This is a committee (several people hold it together)
positions.secretaryNote: Follows whoever holds the Secretary role.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.intro: Every change to people, roles, positions and organisation settings, with who made it and when. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
